bio: Selisa is a master archer – and she knows it. But that cocky attitude got her stranded in enemy territory after she snuck aboard an invasion fleet. A ranger helped her survive the wilds, but just as friendship grew to love, he was slain – now she carries his spirit wolf bow, and a quest for revenge.
